svg.title: Gamma EH natural writing benchmark: limited neural benefit and web-text overcorrection
svg.desc: JFLEG GLEU: unchanged 40.47, neural 40.62, rules and combined 46.51. CWEB F0.5: unchanged zero, neural 0.77, combined 4.05. Combined CWEB edits: 25 matched, 423 unmatched. 315 of 5881 reference-accepted sources changed. Different metrics must not be compared across datasets. Results do not establish general reliability.
